{{Quote|I'm not surprised. I've warned Intelligence repeatedly about underestimating the range of Skywalker's sensing abilities. Obviously, they didn't take me seriously.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="The Last Command" />}}
The '''Mission to Poderis''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was trying to find out whether [[Poderis]] was a transfer point for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] traffic.

==Prelude==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] used [[Poderis]] as a red herring to throw [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] off in his search for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] traffic. The bait was successful, and Luke infiltrated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] planet.

==The Mission==
{{Quote|Artoo? We've got company. Probably Imperials.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="The Last Command" />}}
On Poderis, Skywalker found himelf trapped on a roof connecting to the shield-barrier, trying to escape certain capture. Luke used his heightend sensing abilities to see if Imperial forces were nearby, and found in addition to an [[Unidentified Imperial Intelligence agent (Poderis)|Imperial Intelligence agent]] who was shadowing him, blank spots in which his powers could not detect anything, which could only mean [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]]. He then knew it was a trap and jumped up to the roof, only to find he could not go anywhere.

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fashioned a protective wrapping for his hand out of a torn piece of the left sleeve of his tunic. He then made a groove in the outside of the wall which he stuck his hand into and began his descent by holding the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in front of him, digging out a slanted path for his hand to follow in. After he went about 100 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] across the wall, he cut a hole in the shield-barrier and went back inside the city.

[[File:CovertShroudManeuver-TLC1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] using a [[Covert Shroud Maneuver]] to lure the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].]]
Understanding that the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] would not capture Skywalker, Grand Admiral Thrawn let the Jedi leave the planet in order to capture him in space. The [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] tried to intercept Skywalker's [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]] in the [[Poderis system/Legends|Poderis system]], but the Jedi managed to escape using a [[Covert Shroud Maneuver]], a move that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] flight [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Gibbon Lightmoon]] had helped design.

==Aftermath==
On the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Rejlii Mithel|Mithel]] who was the officer in charge of one of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] did his best to thwart Skywalker's trick, switching tractor beam modes. Rejlii was promoted to [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] by Grand Admiral Thrawn for his ingenuity and assigned to formulate an effective countermeasure to the covert shroud.
